question: Who was appointed as the youngest US Ryder Cup captain since 1963?
solution:
p- The correct answer is __**Keegan Bradley**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **July 8, 2024**, the **PGA of America** officially announced the appointment of **Keegan Bradley** as the captain for the **U.S. Team** in the **2025 Ryder Cup**.
 
• At the age of **38**, Bradley is the **youngest person** to lead the **United States** team since **Arnold Palmer**, who served as a playing captain at the age of **34** in **1963**.
 
• The **2025 Ryder Cup** is scheduled to be held at the iconic **Bethpage Black Course** in **Farmingdale, New York**.
 
• **Keegan Bradley** is a well-known **American professional golfer** who won the **2011 PGA Championship** in his major debut and has represented the **U.S.** in two previous **Ryder Cups** (**2012** and **2014**).
